mapper.select: SELECT comments.id AS "id", comments.parent_comment_id AS "parentCommentId", comments.author_id AS "authorId", comments.content AS "content", comments.created_at AS "createdAt", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reactions.type = 'LIKE') AS "likeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reactions.type = 'DISLIKE') AS "dislikeCount" FROM comments JOIN posts ON posts.id = comments.post_id AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN reactions ON reactions.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND reactions.target_id = comments.id WHERE comments.post_id = #{postId} AND comments.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY comments.id ORDER BY comments.created_at ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments JOIN posts ON posts.id = comments.post_id AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE comments.post_id = #{postId} AND comments.deleted_at IS NULL
